title: fix(spec): a locale bundle's page label no longer replaces a page:header title that says something else
body:
Fixes #22508
Clause-②: no

## What changes

`translatePage` (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`) used to resolve a root-level `page:header` title as the bundle's `pages.NAME.title`, else the bundle's `pages.NAME.label`, and write it over whatever the header authored. A locale pack that translated the page label and left out the title therefore replaced a record page's dynamic `'{name}'` heading with the page's static name in that locale, with nothing warning at build, lint or serve.

The header title now resolves through ONE function, `resolvePageHeaderTitle`, called from the one visitor both roots pass through (a region's entry and a `slots.SLOT` entry both arrive with `nested: false`), so the two roots cannot disagree:

1. the bundle's `pages.NAME.title`, across the locale chain;
2. the header's AUTHORED title, left as written (a template, a plain string, or an inline locale map);
3. the bundle's `pages.NAME.label`, only where the header authors no title, or where its title restates the page's own authored `label`.

The declared contract is restated with that limit in the same PR: the `pages` JSDoc and the `pages.NAME.title` describe in `translation.zod.ts` (and the regenerated `content/docs/references/system/translation.mdx`), the `translatePage` docblock, the hand-written `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` callout, and the `pages` row of `packages/spec/liveness/translation.json`.

## One deviation from the triage text, measured, and why

Triage `6085431021` reads: "The bundle's page `label` stands in only where the authored header has no title of its own." Step 3 above adds one case to that: a header title that restates the page's own `label`. The triage expected nothing to rely on the label replacing an authored title. The measurement says something does:

- `os i18n extract` (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`, the page-header pass) deliberately offers NO `pages.NAME.title` key when the header title restates the page label: "`title` duplicating `label` is the common case and resolves via the label fallback, only emit it when the two genuinely differ" (`sameAuthored`). Every skeleton it has written relies on the label reaching such a header.
- In this repo, three shipped pages are that shape: `marketplace_installed`, `cloud_connection_settings` (`@objectstack/cloud-connection`) and `connect_agent` (`@objectstack/mcp`). Each authors a header title equal to its page label, and `@objectstack/platform-objects`' bundles carry `label` + `subtitle` and no `title` for them in all four locales (en, zh-CN, ja-JP, es-ES).
- Applied literally, the triage sentence turns those three Setup headers back to English in zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES. The ablation below measures it: `packages/cli/test/platform-page-i18n-parity.test.ts` ("rewrites the page:header copy end-to-end for a non-English locale") goes red for all three.

Step 3's second case keeps the triage's own principle ("A bundle supplies a translation of an attribute; it does not swap one attribute for another over authored text"): when the authored title IS the page label's text, the label's translation is a translation of that very text. It also keeps the resolver and the extractor a matched pair: the extractor omits `title` exactly when the resolver will read the label for it. The comparison (`sameAuthoredText`) mirrors the extractor's `sameAuthored` (strings by text, inline maps as sets of non-empty entries). The seat may rule otherwise; the alternative is in the report's `open_questions`.

What still changes for an author (named in the changeset): a header whose title says something else than the page label, in a locale whose pack carries `label` but no `title`, now shows the authored title. In this repo that population is zero (H3 below); the reporting app (hotcrm) already writes `title` in every pack.

## Measurements (dispatch hypotheses)

- **H1, holds.** `translatePage` is reached only through `translateMetadataDocument('page', …)` (the `METADATA_DOCUMENT_TRANSLATORS` table). Its only runtime callers are `translateMetaList` and `translateMetaDocument` in `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`, which serve `GET /api/v1/meta/page` and `GET /api/v1/meta/page/NAME`. The console reads those doors: objectui's `useObjectLabel` resolves only `pages.NAME.label` client-side (the page's nav label) and nothing reads `pages.NAME.title` there. One fix covers both reach points the card names.
- **H2, holds.** The authored title reaches `translatePage` as written in `properties.title` (the REST door serves the stored or packaged document; `PageComponentSchema` is strict, so `properties` is the only place a title can be authored). Pinned at both roots: a template (`'{name}'`), a plain string, an inline locale map, absent (`{}`, `''`), and a title restating the label (string and map forms).
- **H3, does not hold as stated.** In-repo bundles with a `pages` group: `@objectstack/platform-objects` (4 locales, 6 page entries each) and `examples/app-showcase` (zh-CN, 4 entries, `components` only). Pages whose bundle carries `label` and no `title` while a root-level header authors a title: **3** (the three Setup pages above), all of them title-restates-label, all kept translated by step 3. Pages of the defect shape (header title differs from the label, pack has `label` and no `title`): **0**. The `sys_*_detail` pages carry a label-only entry but no `page:header`. app-crm, app-todo and app-multi-package carry no page translations.

Clause-② measured: no accept set or public surface widens. No schema, key, accepted value, default or export changes; the helpers are module-private. What changes is what a translated page RENDERS, which is resolver behaviour. The one schema-adjacent change is the `pages.NAME.title` describe string.

## Tests

All readings below are at head `194157f5e1` (the last commit; no commit followed any of them). Wall-clock figures are shared-box seconds.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local`: 631 files, 18842 passed, 1 todo. `--project repo`: 54 files, 915 passed. `src/system/i18n-resolver.test.ts` alone: 327 passed (the new `#22508` block is 13 cases: six per root plus the REST-door case).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` (tsc, scripts typecheck, `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- `@objectstack/cli` unit layer, the two files that feed `translatePage` and the extractor: `test/platform-page-i18n-parity.test.ts`, `test/i18n-extract.test.ts`, 51 passed (CLI resolves `@objectstack/spec` through `dist`, built at this head).
- `@objectstack/rest` (the one runtime caller): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run`: 273 files, 5166 passed, 327 skipped (rest resolves `@objectstack/spec` through `dist`, rebuilt clean after the ablation).
- Fixture triage (one fixture): `regionHeaderWithId()` in the batch #58 block omitted `PageSchema`'s required `label` while its header restated `homePage()`'s label. Disposition: add the declaration (`label: 'Sales Home'`), so the fixture is the shape it was cut from. No other fixture in the rule's consumer radius changed (platform-objects, cli, lint, rest fixtures read; only the CLI parity test exercises the header title, and it stays green).
- eslint, narrowed and proven: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the three changed TS files reports 3 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. Population: `eslint.config.mjs` lints `**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts,js,jsx,mjs,cjs}`, so the `.md`, `.mdx` and `.json` files in this diff are outside it. Invariance: the config never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no typed rules, stated in the config itself), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.

### Ablations (one-shot, both legs restored and proven)

- Leg 1, the old fallback restored (`resolvePageHeaderTitle` answering bundle title, else bundle label, whatever the header authors), through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1, blob changed): `i18n-resolver.test.ts` 7 failed / 320 passed. The 7 are exactly the predicted ones: template, plain string and inline map at each root, plus the REST-door case. The controls (pack with `title` replaces; no authored title shows the label; title restating the label) stayed green. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Leg 2, the triage sentence applied literally (the restates-the-label disjunct removed), spec rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in `dist`: spec 6 failed / 321 passed (the two restates-label pins, the original `connect_agent` pins and the batch #58 pins), and `platform-page-i18n-parity.test.ts` "rewrites the page:header copy end-to-end for a non-English locale" went red at its first page, `marketplace_installed` (`titleChanged: false`: the zh-CN header stayed "Installed Apps"). Restore leg: source blob equals HEAD, spec rebuilt, preflight `--absent`: marker absent from all 232 built files, tree clean.

### Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 111 families from this diff (the 85 the dispatch named plus 26 the docs and changeset paths add). All 111 ran and recorded an exit code; `--ran` reconciles 111 derived, 111 run, 0 NOT MEASURED. 110 exit 0. One exits 1: `pnpm check:platform-checklist`, on `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/attachments-storage.json`, whose anchor `attachment-access-hooks.ts#canEdit` lost its declaration in `ce3d0ad419` (#22513). That is red on `main` at this branch's base and at `origin/main` `ee8751d41e` too; this diff touches neither file. Seven gates first refused with PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3, unbuilt `lint` / `client-react`); they were re-run after the build and pass, as were the dist-reading gates after the ablation's restore rebuild.

## Acceptance notes

- **Ruled control, recorded rather than changed:** a root-level `page:header` with NO authored title still receives the bundle's page `label` (the triage's third pin). On a record page that is not neutral: `PageHeaderProps.title` documents "omit to let the renderer derive the heading from the record", and objectui's `PageHeaderRenderer` draws `properties.title` when one is present, so a pack that translates the page label replaces a record-derived heading with the static label, the same failure as this card in another shape. In this repo the population is zero: no root-level `page:header` without a title sits on a page with a translated label (the `sys_*_detail` pages carry no header). A Studio-seeded record page stores its synthesized header without a title, so it can be reached outside this repo; measured only by reading, not at a door. Raised as an open question in the report, not changed here.
- **Locale chain, unchanged:** step 1 walks the request's whole locale chain (the locale, then its declared `fallbackChain`) before step 2. So a request whose own pack has only `label`, while a pack on its fallback chain has `title`, shows that fallback title over the authored one. That is still the bundle's title, which the triage put first.
- **Pre-existing red on main:** `pnpm check:platform-checklist` (see Gates). Its carrier is whoever re-anchors the `attachments-storage` checklist item after `ce3d0ad419`; not this PR's file surface.
- Generated output: `content/docs/references/system/translation.mdx` was regenerated by `gen:docs` from the new describe (`check:generated` named exactly that one artifact stale). No other generated artifact moved; `authorable-surface.base.json` untouched.
